proposed_claim: The hierarchy mismatch is class-specific, not a simple stand-wide vertical offset.
numerical_evidence: Across 24 class-year comparisons, mean-height differences range from -4.379 to 0.407 m while density-share differences sum to approximately zero within each year.
limitations: This establishes redistribution across classes, but not the causal mechanism by itself.

proposed_claim: The baseline model allocates effective vertical growth strongly along the hierarchy encoded by status.
numerical_evidence: Class mean status ranges 0.034--0.932; mean effective height velocity 7.084e-04--0.0140; mean height-growth field 0.0066--0.0213.
limitations: This is a diagnostic of the implemented baseline mechanism, not evidence that the allocation is biologically correct.

proposed_claim: The growth-field/status covariance is consistently negative within hierarchy classes.
numerical_evidence: Covariance range -2.982e-04 to -1.453e-05 across 24 class-year combinations.
limitations: The covariance is descriptive and depends on the joint lower-tail cumulative status definition.
